assumptions: The provided excerpt did not include a full field definition for the List All Agents response, so email, name and created_at mappings use field names that appear elsewhere in the docs and may need verification against a live response.
Only agents are treated as licensed users; contacts represent end-customers/requesters and are not included in the user list.
Agent status, role and deactivation values were not documented in the excerpt, so those fields are left null and suspended or deactivated agents cannot be distinguished yet.
Pagination for agents is assumed to follow the standard listing behaviour documented for tickets and contacts using page, per_page and link header.
Rate limits vary by plan from trial to Enterprise, so 700 per minute is used as the documented maximum and the actual limit depends on the customer's plan.
No per-user last-active field and no detailed audit-log record format were documented, so usage is marked unavailable.
